title: GHZ-Equivalent State Distribution in Quantum Networks: Reducing Decoherence and Quantum Resource Consumption
summary: This study proposes a novel scheme for distributing GHZ-equivalent states across repeater-based quantum networks, with particular focus on the analysis and mitigation of decoherence effects during transmission. The proposed scheme enables remote users to share graph states, which can be leveraged to implement various quantum communication protocols, such as quantum key distribution and quantum secret sharing.
